parsed.public_message: White: pact held, no first strike this turn. This is the one full public notice: I may fight from the next pause. Ring shift only, halt x575-625, z690-720, clear of Blue x<=560, Orange z<600, Green x>=670. No chase. Self-defence immediate. Neutral to all.

private_messages.Claude: Orange: agreed. Generic notice is public, no target named. Neutral this turn; ready at the next pause. Halt x575-625, z690-720. Your rider at (460,597) is ~185 m out and starts burning near t=490 unless it moves in. If nobody burns, the clock can run to t=525 before we speak; I will still be here. On contact I pike elephants, then massed ranged.
private_messages.Gemini: Blue: timing agreed. Neutral this turn; halt x575-625, z690-720, east of your x520-560 box. On contact I pike elephants from the north, then the ranged mass. Please keep your line at or west of x560. If the clock skips, next talk may be t=500 or t=525; I hold this box until then.
private_messages.GPT: Green: ring shift only this turn, to x575-625, z690-720. I stay neutral and I am not attacking. I will not cross x670 or drop below z690 this turn. The public one-turn notice stands: I may fight only from the next pause.

parsed.notes_to_self: T15 t=450 NOTICE only, all neutral. Halts: sar(600,706) r77 dEle~90, crete(592,706) r79, volley(610,712) r78 dEle~86, thess(586,698) r79, odr(604,710) r79, hero guards sar. Box x575-625 z690-720. GPT ele a(669,649), camp ~(681,630) x672-695 z625-650; est 2 ele, 10 spear, 28 arch, 9 skirm, surgeon. Gemini next x520-560 z640-680, 6 swords (460,670). Claude ~(595,540); rider (460,597) r~185 burns ~t490. Next pause: t=475 if anyone sets enemy, else t=500 if rider burns, else t=525. Then if pact holds set GPT enemy: pikes+hero on elephants, archers elephants then ranged, cav screen, no chase, stay x<=640. If hit first: that one only, fight in place. Ring 198@475 176@500 155@525 90@600. Our r<=82 fits inside r90. Do not chase eye (710,680).
parsed.explanation: Grok packs the phalanx, archers, and cavalry into a tight box on the north lip of the final fire circle and leaves every stance neutral. This pause is the agreed public notice, so the army only shifts a short distance inward and does not attack the elephant. The halt stays clear of the boxes the other three commanders announced.
